1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe in an OFDM network, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, the method comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier and __separated from a second set of subcarriers by a predetermined interleaving pattern__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating the second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first broadcast channel carries system information and the second broadcast channel carries quick page and control information in the same symbol__.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from a uniform distribution and is interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __and interleaved with the first set of subcarriers according to the predetermined interleaving pattern__.

5. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, further comprising, for a second one of the symbols, allocating substantially all the subcarriers to the second broadcast channel __while maintaining the interleaved allocation of the first and second sets of subcarriers in the first symbol__.

6. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and control information, __wherein the system information and quick page and control information are simultaneously transmitted in the first symbol using the interleaved subcarrier allocation__.

19. (Currently amended) A superframe generator in a base station in an OFDM network, comprising a preamble generator operable to generate a superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols for a superframe by (i) for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier and __separated from a second set of subcarriers by a predetermined interleaving pattern__, and (ii) for the first one of the symbols, allocating a second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first broadcast channel carries system information and the second broadcast channel carries quick page and control information in the same symbol__.

20. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __and interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

21. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that differs from a uniform distribution and is interleaved with the second set of subcarriers__.

22. (Currently amended) The superframe generator as set forth in Claim 19, the first broadcast channel comprising a first primary broadcast channel operable to carry system information, and the second broadcast channel comprising a second primary broadcast channel operable to carry quick page and other control information, __wherein the system information and quick page and control information are simultaneously transmitted in the first symbol using the interleaved subcarrier allocation__.
